websocket._comment: WebSocket keepalive (seconds), forwarded to websockets.serve(). The websockets library default of 20s/20s is too aggressive for terminal clients (casino_client, etc.) whose main loop interleaves blocking stdin reads — pings go unanswered during those reads, the server hits the 20s timeout, and the next client send gets ConnectionClosedError 1011. 60s/600s gives the operator 10 minutes between actions before the server considers the connection dead.
